en: Private, show Lieutenant Reethe some mercy.

This outfit really brings out the blue in my eyes, don't you think? It should be obvious I have plenty of skill to go around, so I can afford to share a few of my tricks of the trade. Listen up, okay?
Information... With our scouts and agents, we control the flow of information in Lordaeron. Scourge movements, their holdings, all underneath our watchful eyes...
Stop! You maggots call that fighting? That is pathetic! Now put your hearts in it, you don't need them anymore anyway!
It's a mystery of the past indeed! But a key to our future!
Ssserenity...at lassst!
Kroshius live? Kroshius crush!

<Thrall laughs.>$B$BSo much to learn still, $r.$B$BYou are too young to remember the wars and bloodshed of ages past. Too young to remember the burden of the curse carried by our people.$B$BOur position with the Alliance right now is a tenuous one. Skirmishes and smaller battles do take place, but there is peace - something our people have not known for millennia. Would you give this up and plunge us into the maw of chaos again but against a new foe? One that will not rest until we are all destroyed?
It seems the army of the Scourge has come to Tanaris. A significant number of their necropolises and other forces have been dispatched there.$B$BNumber of Necropolises remaining: $2283W
%s is summoned through a temporal rift!
Breathe no more!
%s swaggers heavily.
You are welcome, have a nice day.
What does Dadanga like to eat?
The ingots are for display only!

Welcome one and all to the Darkmoon Faire, the greatest event in all the world!  We have it all... delicious food, strong drink, exotic artifacts, fortunes read, amazing prizes and excitement without end!  Don't forget to turn in your Darkmoon Faire Prize Tickets to Gelvas Grimegate!  All it takes is five or more and you're on your way to the most wondrous prizes on all of Azeroth.  Everybody is a winner!
Tell me about graveyards.
Making it out of here without a blade in your back or poison in your veins would be an accomplishment.
Soon you will know the price of your meddling, mortals... The master is nearly whole... And when he rises, your world will cease.
It'll be quick, but it won't be painless!
Make this inn your home.
Can ye hear it, stranger? The humming is gettin' louder with each passing day. These crystals must be what's driving these bugs crazy.
Please do.
I want nothing to do with Silithus, the Qiraji and least of all, any damned dragons!
There's the stolen shredder! Stop it or Lugwizzle will have our hides!
Aye, Remulos. Prepare the mortal races.
Why did you kill me, $n?
Let none get by!
Get the key and unlock these chains! Hitah'ya the Keeper holds it... back of cave...
Well, if it isn't $n!  It's good to see you again; I cannot express my gratitude enough at the help that you've given me and my invention work to date.$B$BWhat can I do for you today?
%s searches through the skulls...
For once I agree with you... scum.
Thank you, $n. Now my spirit will finally be at peace.

As I was saying, I held onto that scepter shard for a good five-hundred years and it was nothing but trouble. It attracted all kinds of attention - the wrong kind of attention. I want to be left alone to my studies not babysit some would be hero's ticket to glory. So... I gave it to the fish.
Another way? Do tell...
The fish is exquisite, Jessica.
The Council of Duskwood must take action.  Evil lingers in the air.
%s tosses fitfully in troubled sleep.

I guess your first exercise is going to be to mine your way down to the Undercity.  Heh, get it?  Mine... nevermind.  To get to the Undercity go to the rear of the Ruins of Lordaeron south of Brill, and take the elevator down.  Ask one of the Undercity Guardians there for further assistance.
Time to bash!
Let's start a new battle, and beat the Horde this time!

Stonetalon Mountain has many perilous caves through out this region.  Exploring these caves can hold many adventures for those willing to risk life for glory.$B$B$C, perhaps you seek riches that only following your heart and soul can garnish.
%s emerges from the plant, allowing it to heal.
My mouth waters just to think on it.  Pyall Silentstride is the finest cook in Bloodhoof Village.  You will find him in the great tent at the northwest corner of the village.
Where is Elder Bellowrage?

You look like you might be needing passage across the Great Sea. Well you have come to the right place, this here is the berth of the Maiden's Fancy, finest passenger ship to travel these waters. When she arrives, just climb aboard and the next thing you know you will find yourself basking on the sandy beaches of Stranglethorn.
Where is Elder Morningdew?

Cool your heels!$B$B<Bodley grumbles something under his breath about the impatience of the living>$B$BAs I was saying, Lord Valthalak's spirit and spectral assassins, summoned forth through his necromantic dabbling, started to assail us. Let me tell you, at that point we weren't in any condition to fight back, so we ran. I can still remember Mor Grayhoof, one of our druids, slip and fall at one point into the lower reaches of the spire.$B$BThe rest as they say, is history.
I'd like training!
Ask Kibler about the treasure! SQUAWK!
I am Bolvar Fordragon, Highlord of Stormwind.
$n has assaulted the stables!
They have broken into the Hall of Lights!  We must stop the intruders!
I can smell your fear, $r.
Ok, let's get this orb made...

That is a fine weapon indeed $n. You guide the spirits like few I have ever known. Listen to them and they will guide you as you have guided them. Go, seek out the Orc known as Kelgruk Bloodaxe. He does not speak with the spirits but he does listen, and his weapons are the finest I have ever laid my eyes upon.
Let us return to the grove, mortal.
What do I look like, the Grand Poobah of enchanters? Your skills require the guidance of an Artisan! Go find Kitta Firewind at the Tower of Azora.
Me scared! Me run now!
